# Guided Review

> A better way for humans to review AI-generated code. Chrome extension for GitHub PRs and CLI for local git diffs — clusters changes into ordered review units with short summaries. Free, open source, bring your own LLM key.

Guided Review is a Chrome extension for github.com pull requests and a local CLI (`npx @guided-review/cli`) for branch, commit, or working-tree diffs. AI structures the walkthrough; humans still decide. It never auto-approves PRs, never “reviews for you,” and has no product backend: traffic goes only to your AI provider (and GitHub for the extension).

---

## What it does

### Chrome extension

On a GitHub PR page, Guided Review adds a **Start Guided Review** button. When you start a review, the extension:

1. Reads the PR’s unified diff (fetched in the background service worker)
2. Sends that diff to **your** configured AI provider (Anthropic, OpenAI, or Grok) with your own API key
3. Turns the response into a sequence of **review units** — logical groups of hunks with short commentary
4. Shows those units in a Shadow DOM overlay so you step through the change set in a sensible order (schema, logic, call-sites, tests — not alphabetical files)

You stay on GitHub. Optionally draft line comments and submit Comment / Approve / Request Changes from the overlay.

### CLI

In any local git repo:

```bash
npx @guided-review/cli
```

The CLI binds localhost, opens a browser UI, and walks the same kind of review units. Pick branch vs base, uncommitted work, or a specific commit. **Structure with AI** is opt-in. Line notes stay local; **Generate Prompt** copies a coding-agent prompt — no GitHub submit. Requires Node.js 22+. The binary is `guidedreview`. `npx guided-review` (unscoped, hyphen) is a different package.

### Shared ideas

- **Review units, not file lists** — Related hunks are clustered so you read the change, not the alphabetical tree
- **Keyboard-first** — Navigate units, search the diff, and comment without leaving the keys
- **Short summaries** — Optional two-line overviews per unit; take them with a grain of salt
- **BYO key** — Claude, OpenAI, or Grok; extension keys in `chrome.storage.local`, CLI keys in env / `~/.config/guided-review/config.json` / coding agents
- **Open source** — Apache-2.0; fork, audit, or point at another provider

### What it does not do

- Does not auto-approve or reject pull requests
- Does not replace human judgment or “taste”
- Does not run a Guided Review backend for review data — no SaaS product API for diffs or keys
- Extension does not work outside `https://github.com/*` (no GitHub Enterprise custom hosts or other forges yet); CLI works on any local git repo

---

## How a review plan works

Pipeline (high level) — shared by extension and CLI via `@guided-review/core`:

1. **diffParser** — Parse the real unified diff into files and hunks
2. **buildPrompt** — Chunk large diffs by file (never splits a single file); ~60k characters per chunk
3. **Provider stream** — User’s Anthropic / OpenAI / Grok client streams a plan
4. **streamPlanParser / reviewPlan** — Validate structure; drop bad hunk ids
5. **Overlay** — Render units from the real diff + plan commentary

Extension sessions live in `chrome.storage.session`, keyed by `owner/repo#number`. Optional GitHub device OAuth is only required to submit reviews from the overlay — not to generate or walk a plan. CLI sessions live with the running localhost server.

Cost: one annotate call per diff chunk when a provider is configured (CLI: only when you Structure with AI). Walking units, searching, drafting, submitting, and Generate Prompt do not call the model again.

---

## Getting started

**GitHub PRs**

1. Install the extension (Chrome Web Store or load unpacked from source)
2. Open options and configure an AI provider + API key
3. Open any github.com pull request and click **Start Guided Review**
4. Step through units; optionally draft line comments and submit

**Local changes**

1. `npx @guided-review/cli` (Node.js 22+)
2. Pick a diff scope; optionally Structure with AI
3. Walk units; leave notes; Generate Prompt if useful

## Privacy model

- **Extension and CLI product paths** talk only to your AI provider (and GitHub for the extension). There is no Guided Review backend for diffs, keys, or review traffic.
- **Extension API keys and settings** stay in `chrome.storage.local`. **CLI** prefs stay in `~/.config/guided-review/config.json` (or XDG / env override).
- **Extension active session** (diff, plan, step index) lives in `chrome.storage.session` until the browser session ends. **CLI session** lives with the running server.
- **Draft comments / notes** stay local until the user explicitly submits (extension) or Generate Prompt copies them (CLI).
- **Marketing site** may use analytics for page views and CTA clicks; the extension and CLI do not embed product analytics.

Details: [Privacy & data](https://guidedreview.dev/docs/privacy-and-data) · [Privacy Policy](https://guidedreview.dev/privacy)
